chunks: From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurara, who said:

When you place the deceased in his Lahd (grave niche), recite Ayat al-Kursi and strike your hand upon his right shoulder, then say, 'O so-and-so, say: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, and with Islam as Religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) as Prophet, and with Ali (peace be upon him) as Imam,' and name the Imam of his time.

key_terms.آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ: The Verse of the Throne (Quran 2:255), a significant verse for recitation in various rituals.
key_terms.إِمَامَ زَمَانِهِ: The Imam of his time, referring to the specific living Imam during the deceased's life or at the time of burial.
key_terms.رَضِيتُ: I am pleased with, a formulaic affirmation of faith and acceptance.
key_terms.لَحْد: A deep, narrow niche in the grave, typical of the Arabian style of burial.

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended rituals and recitations when placing the deceased in the grave according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi details the specific ritual for interring the deceased, emphasizing the recitation of Ayat al-Kursi and the physical act of striking the right shoulder to facilitate the soul's transition. It uniquely highlights the Shia doctrine of Imamah by requiring the affirmation of Ali as Imam and the naming of the current Imam of the era, linking individual death to the broader theological framework of divine leadership.

en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Zurara,

‘Heasws said: ‘When you place the deceased in his chasm (Lahad), recite Ayat Al Kursy (Chapter 2:255), and strike your hand upon his right shoulder, then say, ‘O so and so! Say, ‘I am pleased with Allahazwj as Lordazwj, and with Al Islam as Religion, and with Muhammadsaww as Prophetsaww, and with Aliasws as Imamasws’, and name the Imamasws of his time’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is a narration from him (narrator of previous Hadith) by his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, that when you place a deceased in his grave, read Ayatu al-Kursiy and hold his right shoulder with your hand, then say, ‘O so and so say, “I accept Allah as the Lord, al-Islam as the religion, Muhammad as the prophet and Ali as the Imam.” Then mention the Imam of his time.’””
